sources.计时真源: /tmp/test-timing-raw.txt（398 个 TAP subtest，Σ单测 765,879.8ms，harness 自报 wall 293,688.9ms）

law: 2026-08-03 陛下定谳四条：①≤100s 常规预算（背景）②最小必要成本＝唯一判准 ③闸类负向案不可删 ④测试也是复杂度

projectedSeconds.basis: Σ 单测耗时口径（可直接由 /tmp/test-timing-raw.txt 逐条加总复核）

wallFrame.assumption: 并行度不变（0.383 wall/Σ），且共享冷装夹具全程串行不可并行——两条都往悲观取。

assumptions: delete → 0（16 条合计仅 70ms，对预算无意义，价值在复杂度不在秒数）。
merge → 被并方 ≥1s 的按保留 20% 计残值（并入方要多跑一点），<1s 的按 0 计。
rebuild → ≥1s 的按保留 10% 计（各卷实测成本校准是 30–800× 价差，10% 是刻意悲观），<1s 的按保留 50% 计。
凡审卷自报的 after/saving 估计高于上面模型的，取审卷的（就高不就低）。group-10 取其自报 11.6s、group-13 取 6.5s、collector-receipt 取 0.35s。
另计一次性共享冷装/pack 夹具 55s（单次实测 48.7s + 装机余量）。这笔是全套只付一次的固定成本，也是剩余预算缺口的全部来源。
陛下所述「全套现状 ~1060s」与本次 TAP 捕获对不上（Σ=765.9s / wall=293.7s）。本合账一律以可复核的 TAP 数据为准；若 1060s 口径成立，按同比例落到 ~1060×(190.1/765.9)≈263s。

verdicts.test: normal packaged Navigator drains one healthy preparation across recommendation and silent settlements
verdicts.contract: An in-flight Navigator preparation is drained exactly once before the invocation terminates, and recommendation/human_decision/infrastructure settlements each project the right visibility (advice vs typed silence) with no late or overlapping second call.

verdicts.test: packaged coder apply transforms colliding /skill:tddfoo into canonical tdd expansion

verdicts.test: normal packaged context-loader failure is typed unavailable and preserves the role Receipt
verdicts.contract: When Navigator context loading throws, the role's accepted Receipt is preserved and attendance is a typed unavailable(source=context, cause=context) — i.e. Navigator failure never contaminates the role result.

verdicts.test: installed composition emits admitted-role tool-execution JSONL on stderr for real bash output and never for Navigator prepare
verdicts.contract: In a real `pi` process, admitted-role tool executions emit schemaVersion-1 start/update/end observation records on stderr (never stdout), and the private Navigator session's tool calls are never attributed to the outer role.

verdicts.test: installed composition without --ak-role emits no tool-execution observation records
verdicts.contract: No role activation => zero observation records on stderr (the observation face is role-gated, not always-on).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (闸类契约的 must-reject 负向案)

verdicts.test: installed npm tarball collector runs default gh transport end-to-end in print and json
verdicts.contract: The INSTALLED packaged entrypoint (not the source tree), loaded as the only extension, drives the collector's default gh transport end-to-end: observe returns review evidence, and the output tool accepts a leg verdict yielding typed details (host / repository / prNumber / targetHead / legs / snapshots / evidenceRecords).
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（臃肿：最贵构造被整份重复）＋ 法条④（同形状夹具第二份 = 病）。契约真实且是唯一证明「装出来的包能跑」的腿，故 rebuild 不 delete。

verdicts.test: npm pack includes collector modules, schema, and soul and excludes skills/orchestrator collect
verdicts.contract: The published tarball ships the collector role modules, its JSON schema and soul, and must NOT ship any SKILL.md nor the orchestrator-era souls/collect.md; no orchestrator identifier survives anywhere in the shipped bytes.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（现构造贵于最便宜构造＝臃肿→rebuild：共享夹具/一次冷装全族复用）。契约本身是闸类含 must-exclude 负向案，受③保护，不得删。

verdicts.test: packaged collector help subprocess succeeds
verdicts.contract: The packaged entrypoint boots inside a real `pi` subprocess and answers --help with exit code 0 without timing out.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（与其他测试同根：同一契约重复证明→merge，注明并入谁）。

verdicts.test: isolated packs leave shared dist identity stable under concurrent contract imports
verdicts.contract: packIsolatedPackage() runs the prepack->build lifecycle inside a private materialized root, so packing never rewrites the shared repo dist/ tree that other tests are importing from.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②最小必要成本（现构造远贵于最便宜构造）+ 法条④（重复即病：3 份同形状 pack 夹具）。单测占常规预算 ≤100s 的 63.6%。

verdicts.test: subprocess timeouts are explicit instead of looking like natural no-code closes
verdicts.contract: runPiSubprocess reports a killed-on-timeout child as timedOut=true / code=null instead of letting it look like a clean exit — the guard against every subprocess test in the family going silently green on a hung process.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：构造已在下限。形式上是 helper 测试，但它守的是「测试基础设施能否伪绿」这条真契约，不属于「答不出契约」类。

verdicts.test: hermetic HOME restores the exact prior value and recursively cleans up after a throw
verdicts.contract: withHermeticHome restores the exact prior HOME and recursively removes its temp tree even when the scenario throws — the guard against a leaked HOME contaminating every later in-process test.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：构造已在下限（tmpdir + 一次 throw），且它证明的是跨测试污染这条真契约。

verdicts.test: installed npm tarball runs the complete established-Spec Reviewer lifecycle
verdicts.contract: The installed packaged Reviewer runs its full lifecycle: a bad proposal is rejected and a good one accepted, the canonical skill is injected verbatim into the parent prompt, standards+spec legs dispatch with the capability text withheld from children, the audit revise->pass loop gates the receipt, the working tree is left untouched; plus the no-established-Spec variant (standards leg only, bash confined to the exact accepted diff command) and the refuse-before-dispatch variant.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（臃肿：最贵构造 packIsolatedPackage 又建一遍同一制品）＋法条⑤①（一条测试塞了三条独立外部契约 + 两块根本不需要冷装的断言）。契约真实且含闸类负向案，不可 delete。

verdicts.test: fresh Pi process loads the installed Doctor extension and completes one audited output
verdicts.contract: The published package, cold-installed into a consumer project, is loadable as a Pi extension by a fresh real `pi` process and drives Doctor to exactly one audited output: one recorded ak_doctor_output tool call, one retained compliance-audit row with a pass decision, and a validated Doctor output bound to the activated case path.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造（臃肿）＋ 明列救济「一次冷装全族复用」

verdicts.test: Reviewer Agent reports deterministic setup failures with bounded retention evidence
verdicts.contract: Four contracts fused into one loop: (a) every named fault operation classifies into the right bucket (snapshot/workspace/child) as surfaced by `runner.run`'s thrown outcome envelope; (b) workspace disposition is not-created vs retained-under-tmpdir per fault; (c) runtimeConstructionEvidence is present iff the classification is 'child'; (d) GATE — no `ak-reviewer-child-*` credential scratch dir leaks on any failure path. Plus a fifth, foreign one: (e) the ledger projection round-trip.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造（一次冷装全族复用）+ 法条② 同根（(e) 与 reviewer-execution-ledger.test.ts 重复）+ 法条③（(d) 闸类负向案保留）

verdicts.test: Reviewer Agent cancellation is infrastructure failure and retains its workspace
verdicts.contract: Aborting an in-flight dispatch yields ReviewerDispatchExecutionError with failure 'cancelled' (not 'provider'/'child'/'unknown'), the workspace is RETAINED so a human can inspect it, and no credential scratch leaks.
verdicts.grounds: 法条④ 死代码测试也是病 + 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造

verdicts.test: two Reviewer Agent legs overlap in isolated clones with one pinned ref snapshot
verdicts.contract: The file's tracer bullet: two legs really run concurrently, in separate clones, off ONE pinned ref snapshot; each gets its own session id; each inherits the parent's *resolved* auth (baseUrl/apiKey/headers/env); prompts route to the right axis; the tool grant is honored; workspaces are deleted; and the source repository is byte-for-byte untouched.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造已是最便宜构造（真并发+真隔离无法用进程内缝替代）+ 好测试尺①（一条贯穿真实入口→真实结果的 tracer bullet）

verdicts.test: workspace owner prepares and installs every leg without constructing a provider
verdicts.contract: The workspace owner can prepare N isolated leg workspaces and install + verify the mechanical bundle in each, standalone — no provider, no model runtime, no child session.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造（一次性冷装可全族复用）+ 法条④ 死代码/同形夹具第二份

verdicts.test: Reviewer materializes shallow session snapshot refs into the workspace
verdicts.contract: Materialization preserves the pinned target snapshot (targetHead + every branch/tag/remote ref) even when the session repository is a shallow clone.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根（同一契约重复证明）+ 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造

verdicts.test: Reviewer materializes and verifies a real SHA-256 repository
verdicts.contract: A SHA-256 object-format repository survives snapshot → mirror → workspace with its object format and 64-hex target head intact (and the leg still completes).
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造 + 法条② 同根（尾部断言与 tracer bullet 重复）

verdicts.test: child executor runs in an already-prepared workspace without Git materialization
verdicts.contract: `executeReviewerChild` against an already-prepared workspace emits exactly ['child.reload','child.session'] and no Git materialization operations — i.e. the child path never re-materializes.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造（一次冷装全族复用）

verdicts.test: Reviewer child provider delegates class-private streams to the original receiver
verdicts.contract: Two claims: (a) the child wraps the parent provider by *delegation*, so a provider holding a class-private `#delegate` still receives the stream (spread/Proxy wrapping would break it); (b) GATE — the bash grant is exact-match: `printf exact > allowed.txt` is accepted, `printf widened > forbidden.txt` is rejected and never reaches disk.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ 闸类负向案不可删（must survive the rebuild）+ 法条② 盯文（对自由文本措辞建机械依赖）+ 法条② 同根（auth 断言与 tracer bullet 重复）

verdicts.test: workspace shutdown does not replay pre-creation or post-creation preparation rejection
verdicts.contract: After a classified preparation failure, `owner.shutdown()` is idempotent (calling it twice does not replay or re-raise the rejection) and does not destroy a retained workspace.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根（分类/处置断言与 test:465 的表格重复）+ 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造

verdicts.test: installed Reviewer fatal stages abort without a receipt
verdicts.contract: Each of 4 injected Reviewer failure stages (preflight-git / audit-auth / audit-provider / audit-malformed-decision) aborts with exit 1 and no 'Reviewer report accepted', makes exactly N provider calls, and marks the named tool (Agent or ak_reviewer_output) isError:true with stopReason aborted.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — two cost sins at once: the fixture is rebuilt per row instead of once (共享夹具), and the stage matrix crosses the process boundary for facts the in-process seam already exposes. 法条④ — the per-row clone is the same fixture built 8 times.

verdicts.test: unavailable canonical tdd is infrastructure failure in print and JSON
verdicts.contract: An unavailable canonical tdd Skill — missing / unreadable (path is a directory) / empty body — is an infrastructure failure and never becomes a Coder receipt (no accepted ak_coder_output, no receipt status field).
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — the unavailability matrix is already proved by a construction 823x cheaper, so the current one is by definition not the cheapest. 法条④ — the 3-fixture matrix is a second copy of an existing fixture shape.

verdicts.test: fatal Judge audit failure drains one healthy packaged Navigator without advice
verdicts.contract: On role infrastructure failure, an in-flight Navigator preparation is drained to typed settlement (settlementKind=role_infrastructure_failure) BEFORE input release and process release, stays typed-silent (no ak-navigator-attendance event), and correlates the exact failed Judge output call.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — 现构造贵于最便宜构造. The contract is a pure in-process ordering/lifecycle contract; the subprocess adds nothing to the proof but ~3.4s and a stderr string-parsing layer.

verdicts.test: fatal Judge audit infrastructure failure aborts print and JSON CLI actions
verdicts.contract: A fatal role-audit infrastructure failure reaches the CLI as exit code 1 with no accepted receipt and no success prose, in both the -p print renderer and the --mode json event stream.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — this IS the cheapest construction for its contract: process exit code and print-vs-json renderer separation are only observable across a real process boundary. 法条③ — it is the must-reject negative case of the infrastructure-abort gate (no receipt may be emitted).

verdicts.test: fatal Fixer audit infrastructure failure aborts print and JSON without a receipt
verdicts.contract: Same process-level contract as :252 with role=Fixer — exit 1, no 'Fixer report accepted', in print and json — plus one role-specific fact: the audit retried exactly 3 times (FIXER_AUDIT_FAILURE_PROVIDER_CALLS=3).
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — merge into 'fatal Judge audit infrastructure failure aborts print and JSON CLI actions' (test/audit-failure-subprocess.test.ts:252). The abort path is shared runtime (failInfrastructure); role is a parameter, and print-vs-json is one rendering contract, not a per-role one. 法条③ respected: the must-reject case survives inside the merged table, nothing is deleted.

verdicts.test: abbreviated bases are resolved only among commits reachable from the activation target
verdicts.contract: Abbreviated base revisions resolve only against commits reachable from the pinned activation target — an unreachable object sharing the prefix must not shadow it, and a prefix ambiguous among reachable commits must be rejected as base-invalid.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：契约真实且必须留，但构造是每个候选 commit 一个子进程的暴力生成，贵于最便宜构造一个数量级。

verdicts.test: pinned base resolution ignores moved refs and accepts reachable full commits
verdicts.contract: The reader pins refs at activation: later branch/tag moves do not change resolution, annotated tags peel to their commit, non-commit (blob) refs reject, names ambiguous across pinned refs reject, and forbidden revision syntax rejects.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：契约密度高、必须留，但仓库 seeding 用 ~18 个串行 git 子进程，构造成本高于最便宜构造；与本文件另外 5 处同形状 seeding 重复（法条④）。

verdicts.test: SHA-256 pins full and abbreviated commits, range, material, and ref snapshots
verdicts.contract: Pinning is object-format agnostic: under a SHA-256 repository, full and abbreviated resolution, range, material reads, and ref snapshots all work, and a 40-hex string is NOT accepted as a full id.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：不与 sha1 测试同根（法条②merge 条不适用）——它证明的正是「不写死 40-hex sha1」这条独立契约，且 sha256 仓无法复用 sha1 模板夹具，构造已近下限。

verdicts.test: pinning discovers and canonicalizes the worktree root from nested and symlinked cwd
verdicts.contract: Reader construction discovers the worktree root from a nested subdirectory and from a symlinked path, canonicalizing both to the same realpath root.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：构造近下限——nested + symlink 布局是契约本身要求的形状，无法用更便宜的夹具表达。

verdicts.test: material path safety rejects unsafe Git object paths at the concrete read seam
verdicts.contract: material() rejects absolute paths, parent-directory escapes (direct and embedded), backslashes, and control characters, rejects a path missing from the target, and reads a safe path correctly — enforced at the real Git read seam, not a mock.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③：五条 must-reject 是路径逃逸安全闸的负向案，不可删；法条②：断言在真实读缝上，一个最小仓已是最便宜的可信构造。

verdicts.test: pinning rejects non-repositories and bare repositories
verdicts.contract: Reader construction fails closed for a plain directory and for a bare repository.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③闸类负向案；127ms，构造在下限（一次 --bare init）。

verdicts.test: shared ref snapshot helper canonicalizes immutably and compares order-independently
verdicts.contract: immutableReviewerRefs sorts refs into a frozen canonical map, and sameReviewerRefs compares order-independently and detects value differences.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：0.3ms 纯内存；非「只测内部结构」——这两个是 src/reviewer-git-snapshot.ts 的生产导出，被 reviewer-pinned-git.ts 与 reviewer-workspace.ts 消费，且本测试是它们唯一的证明处。

verdicts.test: shared prompt identity validates exact UTF-8 bytes, length, and SHA-256
verdicts.contract: reviewerPromptIdentity stamps exact UTF-8 bytes/length/digest and isReviewerPromptIdentity rejects a tampered length or tampered text; the stamp is frozen.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（篡改 must-reject）+ 法条②（0.12ms 纯内存）。非重复：本文件是 isReviewerPromptIdentity 的唯一证明处。

verdicts.test: Pi transports malformed Merger candidates to the fatal validator while valid leaves still terminate
verdicts.contract: Pi's real tool transport delivers unknown-field and missing-field candidates to the Merger fatal validator instead of pre-filtering them (one error toolResult, empty details, contract diagnostic), a valid leaf still terminates cleanly, and the fatal path really terminates a process nonzero.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造（进程内缝/最小夹具替代子进程）；负向案本身受法条③ 保留

verdicts.test: production extension observes session repository B, not ambient repository A, through activation and completion
verdicts.contract: The real production extension entrypoint (extensions/role-runtime.ts) binds Merger Git state to the SESSION cwd rather than the process cwd, and a genuine conflicted merge resolved in that repository settles through the output tool with the merge commit accepted.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造（共享夹具）

verdicts.test: role extension binds Merger Git state to session cwd while preserving injected state
verdicts.contract: createRoleRuntimeExtension calls createMergerGitState once per session_start with that session's cwd and returns a fresh state object each time, and never calls the factory when a state is injected.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 已是该契约的最便宜构造（记录式 fake，无子进程无 git）

verdicts.test: Merger terminal contract and singleton failures abort without accepting a receipt
verdicts.contract: Missing required fields, attempt-id mismatch, and a non-sole terminal call each abort exactly once and leave the receipt unaccepted, so a later valid leaf can still terminate.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ 闸类负向案不可删；法条② 最便宜构造（1.6ms 表驱动）

verdicts.test: Merger completion requires exact parents, clean worktree, and no unmerged paths
verdicts.contract: A completed leaf is only accepted when the merge commit has the exact ordered parents, no unmerged paths, a clean worktree, and no resolution edits outside the authorized scope.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ 闸类负向案不可删；法条② 最便宜构造（stub gitState，0.84ms）

verdicts.test: Merger accepts one honest escalation without Git success verification
verdicts.contract: An escalate leaf terminates without any completedMerge verification, and a second terminal call after acceptance is refused.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 最便宜构造；单例负向案受法条③

verdicts.test: Merger activation preflights frozen identity and narrows to the exact resolution tools
verdicts.contract: Merger activation narrows the active tool set to exactly read/grep/find/ls/bash/write/edit + the output tool, and the composed system prompt carries the soul, both intents and the authorized checks while never leaking the input path.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 最便宜构造；含闸类负向断言（不得泄露 /input.json，法条③）

verdicts.test: Merger activation rejects non-conflicts, incomplete conflict sets, and parent drift
verdicts.contract: Activation refuses to start when there is no conflict, when the unmerged set does not match the assignment, when the parents drifted, or when no automatic merge tree is frozen.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ 闸类契约负向案不可删；法条② 已是最便宜构造（表驱动 stub，0.35ms）

verdicts.test: Merger registration exposes both exact terminal leaf shapes without narrowing transport
verdicts.contract: The registered output tool advertises an open schema (no properties/required/anyOf/oneOf) so malformed leaves reach the fatal validator, and publishes exactly the two leaf examples the model may emit.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 最便宜构造（0.23ms 结构守卫）

verdicts.test: request-path abort with deadline exceeded Error cancels without rejected attempt
verdicts.contract: 与 :995 逐字同一契约，只是 abort reason 的 message 换成 "deadline exceeded"。
verdicts.grounds: ②同根 + ④同形夹具第二份：被测代码从不读 reason 的 message。

verdicts.test: request-path AbortSignal cancels hung POST child without rejected attempt
verdicts.contract: POST 在途时 abort：①原样重抛 abort reason（Object.is 同一性）②真子进程被杀 ③attempt 停在 started、不记 rejected ④process-local 一次性额度仍被吃掉。
verdicts.grounds: ②：四条契约里只有②需要真子进程，①③④是纯进程内可证；现构造把四条一起绑在 bash `sleep 30` + mkdtemp + pid 轮询上，四个变体重复付这份钱。

verdicts.test: PATH gh recovery through ledger request+observe sets recoverySnapshotId
verdicts.contract: request 得到 ambiguous_loss 后，下一次 observe 通过 marker 认领自己的评论，把 attempt 标为 recovered 并绑定 recoverySnapshotId。
verdicts.grounds: ②同根：同一契约被证第三遍，且这一遍是最贵的一遍。

verdicts.test: request-path abort with non-Error reason cancels without rejected attempt
verdicts.contract: abort reason 是非 Error 值（字符串）时，仍按同一性原样重抛，不被 instanceof Error 过滤或包装。
verdicts.grounds: ②：契约本身与 :995 有真差别（非 Error 分支），但证它同样不需要真子进程。

verdicts.test: default createGhApiRunner spawns executable gh on PATH hermetically
verdicts.contract: 默认 runner（无 spawnImpl 注入）真的 spawn PATH 上的 gh 可执行文件、按 `--include` HTTP 帧解析响应，且 argv 无 shell 元字符。
verdicts.grounds: ②：真 spawn 那一小块非贵不可证（不可逆地需要真子进程），但本测把 6 个已在别处便宜证过的场景全塞进同一个 bash 脚本，贵在冗余场景而非贵在契约。

verdicts.test: request-path abort with tagged ambiguousGhFailure reason preserves identity over ambiguous_loss
verdicts.contract: abort reason 即使带 `ambiguousGhFailure: true` 标记，signal-aborted 判定也必须先于标记判定——重抛身份，而不是降级成 ambiguous_loss。
verdicts.grounds: ②：这是四变体里信息量最高的一条（钉住 catch 分支的先后次序），但仍不需要真子进程。

verdicts.test: createGhApiRunner stdin EPIPE through createIssueComment is ambiguous_loss
verdicts.contract: 同一 EPIPE 情形经 createIssueComment 包一层后返回 ambiguous_loss。
verdicts.grounds: ②同根：EPIPE→标记 已由 :1038 证，标记→ambiguous_loss 已由 :1020 证，本测只是把两段已证链条再跑一遍，还第二次付了 32 MiB 的钱。

verdicts.test: createGhApiRunner stdin EPIPE settles once without uncaughtException
verdicts.contract: 子进程先退、stdin 写入触发 EPIPE 时，runner 只 settle 一次、拒绝值带 ambiguousGhFailure、且不产生 uncaughtException 崩进程。
verdicts.grounds: ②：真 EPIPE 需要真子进程（这部分不可省），但「写多大」是自由变量，现构造取了 32 MiB——比撑破管道缓冲所需（64 KiB 级）大三个数量级。

verdicts.test: R10 multi-page pagination stops before retaining oversize normalized budget
verdicts.contract: paginate 在追下一页之前先向 retainPage 计费；预算一炸就整体抛错，绝不去取第 3 页。
verdicts.grounds: ②：契约是「计费点在取下一页之前」，与 8 MiB 这个具体数字无关；现构造为了撑爆真实 8 MiB 常量而 `"x".repeat(2.4M)` 造两条巨型 body 并反复 JSON.stringify，是拿数量级换一个布尔行为。

verdicts.test: R11 observe abort through ledger does not certify a snapshot
verdicts.contract: observe 途中 abort → 抛错且不认证任何快照（latestCompleteSnapshotId 未设、allSnapshots 为空）。
verdicts.grounds: ②：契约纯属 ledger 层状态不变式，与真不真 spawn 无关；现构造却靠 bash `sleep 30` 制造挂起，还配 40ms 固定等待。

verdicts.test: R11 hung gh child aborted through runner settles once and kills child
verdicts.contract: （名义）runner 级 abort 会 settle 一次并杀掉挂死的 gh 子进程。
verdicts.grounds: ②：这是全卷证明「真子进程真的被杀」的最便宜位置（只 spawn 一个 hang 住的 child，36ms），但它现在只断言 rejects、根本没验尸——名不副实，逼得 :995 一族四个测试各花 700ms+ 去重复证这件事。

verdicts.test: R6 null user on review/issue comment/review comment preserves record and never qualifies
verdicts.contract: GitHub 把作者 tombstone 成 `user: null` 时，三种表面记录照存但 authorLogin 缺席，且该 review 永不满足 valid，凭它开收据必被拒。
verdicts.grounds: ②契约清晰且构造已是进程内 runner + ledger 真入口；③收据拒收断言属闸类负向案。

verdicts.test: production transport uses gh api --hostname github.com argument vector
verdicts.contract: Every transport call reaches gh as an argv vector starting `api --hostname github.com --include`, never `-c` and never containing shell metacharacters (no shell injection surface).
verdicts.grounds: ②最小必要成本：契约清晰，构造已是最便宜形态（进程内 runner 记录 argv，零子进程）。

verdicts.test: 2xx parse ambiguous_loss recovers via marker observe without second POST
verdicts.contract: 2xx 解析失败造成的 ambiguous_loss，靠下一次 observe 认 marker 恢复，且全程只发过一次 POST（recovery must not repost）。
verdicts.grounds: ②：这是整族 recovery 契约的最便宜构造——同一条 ledger observe+request 真路径，0.54ms；它就是 :296（755ms）该并入的目的地。

verdicts.test: R8 authenticated_user retained raw is login+id only
verdicts.contract: 认证用户证据落库时只保留 login+id，email/plan/company 等 PII 一律不得进入快照。
verdicts.grounds: ③隐私闸的负向断言（`includes("secret@example.com") === false`）不可删；②纯函数直调最便宜。

verdicts.test: non-aborted AbortError+ambiguousGhFailure remains ambiguous_loss
verdicts.contract: signal 没 abort 时，带 ambiguousGhFailure 标记的错误（哪怕 name 是 AbortError）映射为 ambiguous_loss，不得升级为抛出。
verdicts.grounds: ②：进程内 runner 直接 throw 一个打好标记的错误，已是最便宜；③它是 :1013 的负向对偶，成对不可拆。

verdicts.test: 2xx POST parse/normalization failures map to ambiguous_loss; non-2xx rejected
verdicts.contract: POST 返回 2xx 但正文不可解析/缺字段 → ambiguous_loss（可能已发出，禁止重发）；非 2xx → rejected（确定没发出）。
verdicts.grounds: ②：三种坏 body + 一种 422 的表驱动，进程内 runner 直返固定 bodyText，已是最便宜；③ambiguous/rejected 分流是防重发闸。

verdicts.test: normalize helpers accept OPEN and valid review states and reject missing head
verdicts.contract: normalizePullRequest 大写化 state、抽出 head.sha，缺 head.sha 必抛；normalizeReview 保留 userLogin/state。
verdicts.grounds: ②：纯函数契约，纯函数调用即最便宜构造。

verdicts.test: final-page HTTP 429 fails pagination loudly
verdicts.contract: 翻页途中任一页 429 → 整个 listPullRequestReviews 抛错，绝不静默返回部分页（闸类 must-reject）。
verdicts.grounds: ③闸类契约的负向案不可删 + ②构造已最便宜。

verdicts.test: R6 non-null user shapes fail closed on review/issue comment/review comment
verdicts.contract: user 字段的任何非 null 坏形状（缺失/无 login/login 非字符串/非对象）在三种 normalize 上一律抛 `missing user.login`，只有字面 null 才被容忍。
verdicts.grounds: ③闸类 must-reject 矩阵不可删；②纯函数 4×3 矩阵成本 0.14ms，已是最便宜。

verdicts.test: request marker is deterministic for digest/leg/head
verdicts.contract: marker 文本 = `<!-- ak-collector:v1 manifest=<digest前12> leg=<id> head=<oid> -->`，且 request body 逐字保留配置正文并追加 marker。
verdicts.grounds: ②：字符串契约，字面量断言即最便宜；且这是 marker 恢复机制的唯一格式真源（collector-ledger.test.ts:337 只把它当 oracle 反算，不算重复证明）。

verdicts.test: production Merger Git seam freezes the exact automatic merge tree and reports an unrelated resolution edit
verdicts.contract: createProductionMergerGitState reads real git state: activeMerge() reports (targetObjectId, sourceObjectId, unmergedPaths, automaticMergeTreeId) frozen at conflict time, and completedMerge() reports parents, empty conflict set, worktree cleanliness, and every path whose content differs from the frozen automatic merge tree.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（现构造贵于最便宜构造＝臃肿→rebuild，共享夹具/一次冷装全族复用）。契约成立且是本文件唯一的 tracer bullet，故保留其断言并作为 t2/t3 的合并目标；贵的是夹具不是契约。

verdicts.test: production Merger Git seam accepts a clean source-only first-parent change
verdicts.contract: resolutionChangedPaths 以「自动合并树」为基线、不以第一父为基线——source 独有且未被改动的路径不得被报成解决改动。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（与其他测试同根：同一契约重复证明→merge，并入 t1「freezes the exact automatic merge tree…」）。

verdicts.test: production Merger Git seam reports tampering with a clean source-side path
verdicts.contract: 被篡改的 source 侧干净路径必须出现在 resolutionChangedPaths。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（同根：与 t1 同一契约同一代码路径）+ 法条④（同形状夹具第二份＝病）。

verdicts.test: production Merger Git seam reports no conflict set after a non-conflicting merge
verdicts.contract: MERGE_HEAD 存在但无冲突时（git merge --no-commit --no-ff 干净合并），activeMerge().unmergedPaths 必须是空集——不得把「有合并在途」误读成「有冲突」。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（契约成立且与 t1 不同根——t1 无法产生「干净在途合并」态，故不可 merge；但构造贵于最便宜构造：手搓第二个 from-scratch repo）。

verdicts.test: incident 2026-08-02: malformed Fixer prerequisites fail the real Pi subprocess before provider dispatch
verdicts.contract: The real `pi` CLI binary, loading the real extensions/role-runtime.ts, given --ak-fixer-prerequisites pointing at a malformed file, exits 1 with FIXER_AUDIT_FAILURE_PROVIDER_CALLS=0 and emits [started, failed] activation-trace JSONL on stderr with cause AK_INVALID_FIX_PACKET.
verdicts.grounds: 法条④ (同形状夹具第二份) + 法条② (现构造贵于最便宜构造). The spawn block is a second private copy of an existing family harness, and three of its four assertion classes are already proven in-process elsewhere at ~0ms.

verdicts.test: every registered healthy production ignition leaves structured start and completion traces
verdicts.contract: For every registered role, a healthy session_start drives the whole declared stage list and emits exactly [started, completed] per stage, in declaration order, each schema-valid.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — the happy-path census over all 7 roles at 19ms is the cheapest way to prove per-role stage tracing; no subprocess, no npm, all dependencies injected as async literals.

verdicts.test: observation writer failure aborts through real ExtensionRunner emit with original cause
verdicts.contract: Through Pi's REAL ExtensionRunner.emit — which swallows handler throws after emitError — an observation-writer failure still calls ExtensionContext.abort, still sets exitCode 1 in print mode, and still surfaces the original cause as an extension error; for all three seams (start, update, end).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — the must-not-be-swallowed gate at the only layer where the swallow actually happens; 法条② — withInProcessPi is exactly the '进程内缝替代子进程' construction the law prefers, and it costs 13.8ms instead of a ~2s CLI boot.

verdicts.test: registration enrolls every role in stable named activation stages
verdicts.contract: ROLE_REGISTRY is a closed census of exactly 7 roles; every role declares >=1 stage; stage ids are unique within a role; a trace record built from any (role, stageId) validates against activationTraceRecordSchema.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — construction is already the cheapest possible (pure in-memory walk of an exported constant, zero I/O, zero fakes).

verdicts.test: every registered whole-activation rejection terminates nonzero with a named cause before a model turn
verdicts.contract: For every registered role: activation rejection rethrows, aborts, sets exitCode 1, records a failed trace with a named structured cause, and the before_agent_start barrier stops dispatch so the provider is never reached.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — this is the safety gate's must-reject census (provider must never be reached on a failed activation); 法条② — an in-process fake pi with a throwing loader is the cheapest construction for it.

verdicts.test: observation face emits start/end always, throttles producing updates per toolCallId, and ignores non-admitted sessions
verdicts.contract: start/end are always emitted; producing updates are coalesced per toolCallId on a 30s monotonic window; non-producing updates never emit; interleaved toolCallIds keep independent throttle state; a non-admitted session emits nothing.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — the whole behavioural contract of the face proven in 1.3ms with an injected mono counter; a real timer or real Pi session would be orders of magnitude more expensive for the same proof. 法条③ — contains the non-admitted must-not-emit case (:374-379).

verdicts.test: a rejected registered activation fails closed with a structured named cause and dispatch barrier
verdicts.contract: Same law as test 4, instantiated for the judge role only: rejection -> throw, abort, exitCode 1, [started, failed] traces, deepEqual named cause, before_agent_start throws ActivationBarrierError with code AK_ACTIVATION_NOT_ADMITTED.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — 与其他测试同根：同一契约重复证明。Test 4 already loops ROLE_REGISTRY, which includes judge, and already asserts throw + abort + exitCode 1 + failed-trace named cause + the barrier.

verdicts.test: the shared executor runs every declared stage in order
verdicts.contract: executeActivationStages interleaves correctly: started -> stage body -> completed, per stage, in order.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — two synthetic stages and a push-array is the cheapest construction that exists; and it proves interleaving, which test 2 structurally cannot see (test 2 only collects traces, never observes the body running between them).

verdicts.test: failed trace emission cannot mask the activation cause or skip termination
verdicts.contract: When both the activation and the failure-trace write throw, the caller sees an AggregateError carrying BOTH causes in order (activation first), and termination still runs.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — the strongest fail-closed case in the file (an error path that swallows the real cause is exactly the incident class this file exists for); 法条② — cheapest construction, two injected throwers.

verdicts.test: completed trace emission failure still terminates the invocation
verdicts.contract: A writer that fails on the SECOND write (the completion trace, after a healthy activation) still aborts and exits nonzero — success is not faked once the stage body already ran.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — distinct must-fail branch (post-activation writer failure) not reachable by the pre-activation rows above; 法条② — a write counter is the cheapest possible discriminator.

verdicts.test: clock failure terminates before activation instead of degrading silently
verdicts.contract: If the activation clock throws, activation never runs (activations==0), the invocation aborts and exits nonzero — no silent degradation to an untraced activation.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — fail-closed negative case for the trace-infrastructure gate; 法条② — cheapest construction (injected throwing clock, 0.6ms).

verdicts.test: writer failure terminates before activation instead of degrading silently
verdicts.contract: Same law for the trace writer: a throwing writeTrace stops activation before it runs, aborts, exits nonzero.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ + 法条② — second row of a parameterized table, already the minimal form (the shared body is written once at :244-255).

verdicts.test: activation failure applies print exit-code policy
verdicts.contract: In print mode an activation failure sets process.exitCode = 1.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — one row of a 4-row parameterized policy table whose body is written once (:315-322); the table is the minimal encoding of a per-mode policy.

verdicts.test: default trace writer retries transient and short writes until one complete JSONL record
verdicts.contract: writeActivationTraceRecord survives EAGAIN and partial writes and still emits exactly one complete, newline-terminated, schema-valid JSONL record.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — injected writeSync returning min(7, length) is the cheapest way to force the short-write loop; no fd, no file, no process.

verdicts.test: shared role runtime registers tool observation only after admitted activation and never writes stdout
verdicts.contract: tool_execution_* handlers are registered eagerly but stay inert until activation is admitted; after admission they emit start/update/end with the correct role, and non-producing updates are still suppressed.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — pre-admission silence is a gate (an unadmitted session must not leak observation records); 法条② — a fake pi plus handler map, 0.4ms.

verdicts.test: tool-execution observation contract is versioned, closed, and output-driven
verdicts.contract: The observation record schema is versioned (1) and CLOSED (extra key rejected, missing isError on end rejected), and isProducingToolUpdate is output-driven (empty content / empty text = not producing).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — the two Value.Check(...)===false assertions (:338-343) are must-reject cases for a closed schema; 法条② — pure schema/predicate calls, 0.37ms.

verdicts.test: executor rejects schema-invalid dependency output without emitting it
verdicts.contract: A dependency (the clock) returning schema-invalid output makes the executor reject BEFORE any trace is written — no half-valid record ever reaches the stream.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — must-reject case for the closed schema; 法条② — one bad clock + an empty-array assertion, nothing cheaper exists.

verdicts.test: activation failure applies tui exit-code policy
verdicts.contract: In tui mode an activation failure leaves process.exitCode undefined (the TUI owns its own exit).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — this is the negative half of the policy gate (must NOT set an exit code); deleting it would let the policy silently collapse to 'always 1'.

verdicts.test: activation failure applies json exit-code policy
verdicts.contract: In json mode an activation failure sets process.exitCode = 1.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — parameterized table row, cheapest form, 0.2ms.

verdicts.test: activation failure applies rpc exit-code policy
verdicts.contract: In rpc mode an activation failure leaves process.exitCode undefined.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ + 法条② — second negative row of the same table, free.

verdicts.test: observation face rejects throttleMs override at the typed call site and ignores it at runtime
verdicts.contract: throttleMs is not part of the face's typed options, and a smuggled throttleMs:0 cannot disable the fixed 30s coalesce.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — must-reject case for the throttle gate; it is the regression test for commit 1de6063 ('bind observation throttle to fixed 30s constant'), so its negative case is protected. 法条② — 0.19ms, injected mono, cheapest form.

verdicts.test: default tool observation writer retries short writes on fd 2 and rejects schema-invalid records
verdicts.contract: writeToolExecutionObservationRecord writes to fd 2, survives EAGAIN and partial writes, emits one complete schema-valid JSONL line, and throws on a schema-invalid record.
verdicts.grounds: 法条④ — 同形状夹具第二份：the fake writeSync (EAGAIN on call 1, then min(N, length) short writes, chunks pushed into a buffer) is a verbatim second copy of the activation-trace writer's fixture.

verdicts.test: tool observation writer failure does not fake success on the face
verdicts.contract: A throwing write propagates out of face.onStart — the face never swallows a writer failure into a fake success.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — must-not-swallow gate; 法条② — 0.1ms, the cheapest unit-level proof under the 13.8ms real-ExtensionRunner test below (different layers: this one proves propagation out of the face, that one proves abort/exitCode/error-retention through Pi's emit).

verdicts.test: production observation mono clock is monotonic and not wall-clock Date.now
verdicts.contract: systemToolExecutionObservationMonoNow never goes backwards and is not Date.now (so the throttle cannot be broken by clock adjustment).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — regression gate for commit ea5c814 ('monotonic observation throttle'); 法条② — 0.08ms, nothing cheaper exists.

verdicts.test: receipt and ledger overflow latch fatal infrastructure failure
verdicts.contract: When cumulative ledger materialization crosses COLLECTOR_RECEIPT_MAX_BYTES (32 MiB), observe() latches ledger.fatal and throws a non-retriable error carrying collectorFatal:true (src/collector-ledger.ts:427 assertMaterializationWithinBound).
verdicts.grounds: 法②臃肿（现构造远贵于最便宜构造）。法③保护：这是闸的 must-reject 负向案，只准变便宜、不准删。

verdicts.test: F3 receipt exact 32 MiB valid-rationale MAX accept and MAX+1 fatal
verdicts.contract: buildCollectorReceipt accepts a receipt of exactly COLLECTOR_RECEIPT_MAX_BYTES and latches fatal at MAX+1 (off-by-one boundary, src/collector-receipt.ts:804-809).
verdicts.grounds: 法②同根（同一契约重复证明）+ 法⑤①（一个独立外部行为契约最多一条最短 tracer bullet）+ 法⑤②（同根共用一条贯穿真实入口的测试）。法③保护的 MAX+1 负向案在并入方存活，不丢。

verdicts.test: parseCollectorOutputCandidate accepts narrow semantic legs only
verdicts.contract: parseCollectorOutputCandidate accepts only the narrow leg shape (legId/status/rationale/evidenceRefs) and rejects out-of-enum status and unknown leg fields.
verdicts.grounds: 法②同根（同一 schema 契约在两处证明）+ 法⑤①（一契约一条最短 tracer bullet）。

verdicts.test: pre-existing exact-head review with before relation proves valid
verdicts.contract: Canonical happy path: an exact-head APPROVED review submitted before activation yields a valid leg with headRelation 'current', windowRelation 'before', and the receipt embeds the citing snapshot + evidence record.
verdicts.grounds: 廉价（3.2ms，含 fixture 首次预热）且契约清晰；正向配负向的正向锚。

verdicts.test: F3-collision-duplicate-snapshotId

verdicts.test: F3-receipt-overflow-role-path exact MAX+1 through output execute

verdicts.test: F1 real-Pi invalid output rows deny at message_end with zero GitHub

verdicts.test: collector same-session batch provenance matrix freezes transport after fatal

verdicts.test: observe content exposes authenticated request-marker so wait/missing path never creates

verdicts.test: collector rejects parallel operational siblings and mixed output batches
verdicts.contract: Batch gate: an assistant turn carrying two operational tool calls is wholly rejected — every toolResult isError, zero GitHub, exit 1.

verdicts.test: collector replaces first input entirely, strips images, and rejects later input

verdicts.test: observe content exposes exact-head qualifying review for content-only valid path

verdicts.test: F3-ambient-appendSystemPrompt

verdicts.test: collector rejects invalid manifest before provider or GitHub side effects

verdicts.test: collector immediate all-valid path through observe and singleton output

verdicts.test: F3-ambient-skills unsupported hostile sibling-extension injection

verdicts.test: F3-ambient-commands

verdicts.test: F3-ambient-contextFiles

verdicts.test: F1 control: well-formed unavailable is schema-accepted

verdicts.test: collector startup fails closed on required tool collision with zero GitHub calls

verdicts.test: F1 registered collector tool schemas are the singular TypeBox owner

verdicts.test: collector startup with no prompt still exits nonzero on shutdown

verdicts.test: Collector success followed by failed reactivation cannot dispatch stale state

verdicts.test: native provider stream seam classifies auth/quota/transport after setModel without message metadata oracle
verdicts.contract: setModel 换 provider 后，流缝仍按 typed 事实分类失败（onResponse 的 401/429 状态、transport diagnostics），且分类不看措辞；同时 assistant message 上不得留 statusCode/code/navigatorFailure 这些非契约元数据。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（现构造贵于最便宜构造）：它为 3 个 source × 2 种措辞各建一次全新 native session ＝ 6 次 ModelRuntime.create+createAgentSession，本卷 10 次真 session 里它一家占 6 次；但「同一 session 连续两次 prompt 不互相污染」正是 #9 已证的事实（生产侧每次 invoke 前 reset，src/navigator-attendance.ts:864），所以第二种措辞完全不必换新 session。

verdicts.test: native session uses the saved model exactly and rejects unsupported thinking without fallback
verdicts.contract: native factory 精确使用持久化的 model 设置：thinking 不被支持 → NavigatorUnavailableError(source/cause=thinking)，绝不降级；provider 缺失 → (model)；正常解析 → thinkingLevel 'off'。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：这是本卷最贵测试之一（真 native session），但便宜证法不存在于测试侧——生产代码把 thinking 校验放在 createAgentSession 之后（src/navigator-attendance.ts:914），所以「拒绝 thinking」这一款必须真造出 session 才能到达；missing-provider 那款在 :729 提前失败、本就便宜。2 次真 session ≈ 该契约的下限。

verdicts.test: native provider stream seam resets per call and classifies terminal-less completion
verdicts.contract: 失败事实按调用重置（quota→transport 不串味）；provider 无任何 terminal 事件时 prompt() 仍 resolve（不挂死）并归类 transport。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：两块各需一种不同的 provider 行为，2 次真 session 是下限；且第一块已在同一 session 内复用两次 prompt（:459-464）＝ 本卷最省的 native 写法，正是 #8 该学的范式。

verdicts.test: Navigator preparation overlaps settlement, waits for the same call, and presents one typed event
verdicts.contract: 一次 prepare() 与角色回合重叠；settle() 等的是同一次调用（不另起）；对外只出一条 typed event；invocation/settlement/route 三条 session entry 共享同一 invocationId；report 文本含 command。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：这是本模块的核心并发契约，构造已是最便宜的一种——纯进程内假 session（sessionHarness，test/navigator-attendance.test.ts:58），唯一的 IO 是一个 model.json。

verdicts.test: typed owner-decision and role-infrastructure outcomes remain silent
verdicts.contract: human_decision 与 role_infrastructure_failure 两类 settlement 一律不对外呈现（events 为空），但 preparation 仍照常发生（prompts()===2）。
verdicts.grounds: 法条③：这是呈现闸的 must-not-present 负向案，不可删；法条②：构造为进程内假 session，无更便宜证法。

verdicts.test: dispose during pending createSession drains the created session without prompt or assignment
verdicts.contract: createSession 在途时 dispose：迟到的 session 必须被排干（dispose 恰好一次）、绝不 prompt、绝不 setModel、绝不产出 recommendation。
verdicts.grounds: 法条③：四条断言里三条是 must-not（泄漏/竞态闸），不可删；法条②：用一个可控 gate promise 造在途窗口已是最便宜。

verdicts.test: future arrival is typed and presentation-only
verdicts.contract: arrival 类 settlement 产 typed arrival 事件、格式化后即 arrivalMessage 原文，且完全不触发 Navigator 提示（prompts()===0）。
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（prompts()===0 是「presentation-only」的 must-not 断言）＋法条②：进程内假 session，最便宜。

verdicts.test: unchanged routes are omitted after a native-session route entry, while changed settings are reread
verdicts.contract: route 只在变化时再次呈现（未变即省略）；每次 preparation 重读持久化 model 设置，setModel 依次收到 one/two/three。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：三轮状态机契约用一个假 session + 三次 writeFile 证完，已是最便宜构造。

verdicts.test: persistent model edits are immediate and have no fallback
verdicts.contract: 设置文件缺失时读到 NAVIGATOR_DEFAULT_MODEL；写→读往返逐字精确；持久化的非法值不被静默兜底，解析时抛。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：契约清晰、构造只有两次本地文件写，已是最便宜。

verdicts.test: live help changes the next hint without a static template or fabricated task arguments
verdicts.contract: 每次 preparation 重新读取 role --help 实文，下一跳提示随之变；且不伪造 task 参数（不得出现 /repo/task.md 这类捏造路径）。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：契约清晰，构造是进程内假 session + 一个可变闭包变量 help，没有更便宜的证法。

verdicts.test: Navigator session creation failures become unavailable without rejecting settlement
verdicts.contract: createSession 抛错 → 一条 unavailable 事件、source/cause 均为 session、带非空 reason；且 settle() 绝不因此 reject（角色 Receipt 不被领航员拖垮）。两种措辞证明分类不看措辞。
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（settle 不得 reject = 闸的 must-not）＋法条②：注入一个 throw 的 createSession 就是最便宜构造。

verdicts.test: resumed setModel and thinking failures preserve typed source and cause
verdicts.contract: 复用（第二轮）preparation 上：thinking 不支持 → unavailable(source=cause=thinking)；setModel 抛无类型措辞的错 → unavailable(source=cause=session)；第一轮仍正常产 recommendation。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：两种失败都由注入的假 session 直接制造，不需真 native session——这正是 #8 应该学的便宜面；构造已最省。

verdicts.test: session placement is stable, colocated, and isolates ad hoc subjects
verdicts.contract: subject 目录推导：issue 路径稳定且相对/绝对同解；navigator session 与 subject 同址且不自嵌套；ad-hoc 下不同 role 的 run 目录不得把同一工作切成两个 subject，不同工作根互相隔离。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：纯函数，0.24ms，20 条断言，构造无可再省。合并接收 #17。

verdicts.test: authority extraction only admits role-owned validated typed contracts
verdicts.contract: 权限抽取闸：只有通过校验的 merger 契约叶子能供出 authority；任务/包裹 JSON 里自带的 authority/controllingAuthority 一律不得越权注入（fixer/coder/reviewer/collector/judge 全拒），残缺的 merger 形状 JSON 也拒。
verdicts.grounds: 法条③：这是安全闸，六条 must-reject 负向案明令不可删；法条②：纯函数 + 内联 JSON，0.45ms，无更便宜构造。

verdicts.test: model settings are exact and typed settlement projection ignores prose and correctable errors
verdicts.contract: 三件事捆在一起：(a) parseNavigatorModelSetting 精确解析且拒 :backup；(b) publicNavigatorSettlement 只认 typed 事实、忽略措辞与可纠正错误；(c) selectNavigatorCandidate 的 statuses 列表成员匹配。
verdicts.grounds: 法条④（同形状夹具第二/第三份）＋法条②：(c) 段与 #15「status-specific route candidates outrank generics」证的是同一函数的同一契约族，却在此处第三次手搭 candidate 字面量。并入 #15，由一处拥有 selectNavigatorCandidate 契约；(a)(b) 留在本测试。

verdicts.test: registry output tools are the contract-owned constants
verdicts.contract: PACKAGED_ROLE_REGISTRY 的 outputTool 字段等于各契约模块导出的常量（不是手抄字符串），顺带证 fixer 的 unfinished 投影为 accepted。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：0.13ms，且它是防手抄漂移的唯一真源比对。接收 #13 并入的顺序断言。

verdicts.test: typed subject provenance replaces prose prefix branching
verdicts.contract: subject key 的替换语义只由 typed provenance（placeholder/role_input/user_prompt）决定，不由散文前缀触发；合法但恰好以旧前缀开头的真任务仍被哈希成独立 subject。
verdicts.grounds: 法条④（同形状夹具第二份）：与 #12 是同一个函数（navigatorSubjectKey/ForInput）、同一个 `/repo/.ak/work/ad-hoc` 夹具字面量、同一条 subject key 推导契约的相邻条款，分两处各自搭台。

verdicts.test: status-specific route candidates outrank generics regardless of declaration order
verdicts.contract: 候选选择：带 statuses 的具体候选压过通用候选，与声明顺序无关；status 不匹配时回落通用。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②：纯函数，0.14ms。本测试是 selectNavigatorCandidate 契约的归属地，接收 #6 并入的 statuses 成员匹配断言。

verdicts.test: NAVIGATOR_TARGETS preserves packaged registry order
verdicts.contract: NAVIGATOR_TARGETS 按 PACKAGED_ROLE_REGISTRY 原序暴露七个角色。
verdicts.grounds: 法条④（同一事实证两遍）：#18「registry output tools are the contract-owned constants」已经把同一份七角色顺序字面量断言了一遍，且顺带绑定 outputTool；本测试的断言是它的真子集。

verdicts.test: registered Agent preserves production pinned-reader diagnostics for Git preflight failures
verdicts.contract: The PRODUCTION createReviewerPinnedGitReader (not the faux) surfaces material-invalid / base-invalid / range-invalid through the registered Agent's rejection with typed codes and diagnostics, starting no runner.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — a production-git contract cannot be proved without a real repository, and this already builds ONE repo (:95-105) reused across all three rows rather than one per row. That is the cheapest shape available.

verdicts.test: successful Agent result is exactly thin while settled evidence remains internal
verdicts.contract: The Agent tool result is exactly {status, identity} + one text line; reports and prompts never appear in it, while the later receipt carries both axes.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — leak gate: the doesNotContain assertions on 'standards report'/'spec report'/'prompt' are the must-reject side. 法条② 3.68ms.

verdicts.test: runner result axes must exactly equal accepted one- and two-leg dispatch axes
verdicts.contract: A runner returning a fabricated extra axis, a missing axis, or a substituted-prompt axis is rejected before projection, no audit runs, and no later receipt is possible.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — three must-reject counterexamples of the runner-substitution gate. 法条② 3.45ms.

verdicts.test: registered Agent rejection text names the violated proposal or pinned-evidence constraint
verdicts.contract: Each rejection path (empty base.revision, unsafe material id, over-ceiling required tools, missing prerequisite operation, range/base mismatch, nondeterministic prompt compilation, target drift) names the constraint it violated so the child can self-correct.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — 对自由文本措辞建机械依赖. The construction pins seven exact diagnostic wordings by regex when the seam already emits a typed code for every one of them, and the adjacent test in the SAME file proves the cheaper construction works.

verdicts.test: preflight rejection can be corrected, starts no rejected runner, and accepts only one dispatch
verdicts.contract: reject -> correct -> accept, and acceptance is one-shot: a later proposal is closed, not run twice (starts stays 1).
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 2.84ms; a single line through the real tool.execute entry over three states — exactly one tracer bullet for the acceptance lifecycle.

verdicts.test: runner identity and pinned target must exactly match accepted dispatch before settlement projection
verdicts.contract: A substituted dispatch identity or a drifted pinned target aborts before projection and blocks any later receipt; the exact-match path projects identity and target into the audit record.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ gate negatives plus the matching positive in one line. 法条② 2.17ms.

verdicts.test: activation authorizes pin-target before creating the pinned Git reader
verdicts.contract: Capabilities lacking preflight.git.pin-target fail activation before any pinned reader is constructed (pins===0).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ authority gate negative case; 法条② 1.69ms on the shared in-process setup() harness (:41).

verdicts.test: runtime receipt preserves exact report UTF-8 bytes, length, and SHA
verdicts.contract: Report bytes survive into the receipt byte-exactly (leading indentation, blank line, non-ASCII) with matching utf8Length and sha256, and do not leak into the thin Agent result.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 1.65ms; asserts against an independently recomputed digest rather than a recorded snapshot.

verdicts.test: final-review proposal accepts durable hidden authority material after typed path correction
verdicts.contract: A materials path carrying traversal plus an injected instruction line is rejected as material-invalid; the corrected repository-relative path is then accepted.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — this is a prompt-injection / path-traversal gate; its must-reject case is explicitly undeletable. 法条② 1.44ms.

verdicts.test: runtime receipts preserve binding-owned and accepted canonical Skill content identity independent of locators
verdicts.contract: Both a pre-acceptance refused receipt and a completed receipt carry the canonical Skill content identity, and neither leaks the on-disk locator ('/skill').
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — the locator no-leak assertion is a gate negative. 法条② 1.18ms.

verdicts.test: schema-invalid transport settling after acceptance becomes one bounded closed attempt
verdicts.contract: A schema-invalid transport arriving AFTER acceptance is not a rejection but exactly one closed attempt keyed by content digest, started:false, with no raw-secret retention and no second run.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 1.12ms; the ordering (after vs before acceptance) makes it a genuinely different contract from :288, not a duplicate.

verdicts.test: concurrent proposals keep each accepted invocation context and signal bound together
verdicts.contract: Under concurrent proposals, the accepted one carries its own context+signal pair to the runner and the loser closes — no cross-binding.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 1.07ms; a real concurrency interleaving driven by a promise gate, not a mock of concurrency.

verdicts.test: one failed and one successful sibling are both audited before infrastructure termination
verdicts.contract: When one leg fails and its sibling succeeds, the thrown execution error does not leak the sibling's report, the output tool becomes the only active tool, and the later refused receipt still carries both outcomes.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — the 'must not leak the successful sibling report' assertion (:259) is a gate negative. 法条② 0.91ms.

verdicts.test: classified snapshot preparation failure settles into a refused production receipt without shutdown infrastructure failure
verdicts.contract: A classified snapshot failure with a retained workspace settles into a v2 refused receipt carrying the retained path, and shuts the agent down exactly once.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 0.78ms; distinguishes classified-failure (refused receipt) from unclassified (infrastructure abort) — a distinct contract from :318.

verdicts.test: transport schema error records once, clears raw args, then permits corrected acceptance
verdicts.contract: A schema-invalid transport attempt is recorded exactly once, its raw arguments are never retained in the audit record, and a corrected proposal still gets accepted.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — the DO_NOT_RETAIN no-leak assertion (:299) is a secrets gate negative. 法条② 0.78ms.

verdicts.test: completion audits projected facts and revise can be resubmitted without rerunning
verdicts.contract: A revise verdict can be resubmitted and passes on the second audit without re-running the dispatch (starts stays 1), and the audited record carries the exact projected prompts and material bytes.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 0.77ms; one line through audit -> revise -> resubmit -> pass on the real tools.

verdicts.test: activation permits unused ceiling authority absent from the host
verdicts.contract: Declared-but-host-unavailable ceiling tools do not block activation and start no run.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 0.59ms; the positive counterpart to the fail-closed cases, needed so the gate is not merely 'reject everything'.

verdicts.test: runner infrastructure failure blocks refusal and completion before audit
verdicts.contract: An unclassified runner throw propagates, blocks any later refused receipt, and runs zero audits.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ gate negative; 法条② 0.55ms. This is also the in-process seam that should absorb the stage matrix currently proved by 8 subprocess spawns in audit-failure-subprocess.test.ts:366.

verdicts.test: invalid expansion is fatal and makes a later refused receipt impossible
verdicts.contract: A canonical Skill expansion that does not match is fatal at before_agent_start and poisons the runtime so no refused receipt can be issued afterwards.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ fail-closed gate negative; 法条② 0.40ms.

verdicts.test: activation fails closed for absent, malformed, and task-mismatched capabilities
verdicts.contract: Missing flag, unparseable capabilities, and a task digest mismatch each abort activation.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ three must-reject gate cases; 法条② 0.31ms.

verdicts.test: 8 MiB snapshot boundary: measured MAX accept and MAX+1 fail
verdicts.contract: The snapshot byte gate is inclusive: a snapshot measuring exactly the bound is certified with normalizedByteLength === bound, and bound+1 is rejected with fatal latched.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造 — this single test is 62% of the file's runtime purely to hit a hardcoded 8 MiB number; 法条④ — its calibration helper is a second copy of production logic.

verdicts.test: R10 cross-surface normalized budget rejects before later surfaces and terminal PR
verdicts.contract: The observation budget is charged incrementally across surfaces: once cumulative normalized bytes exceed the bound, the remaining surfaces and the terminal PR re-read are never fetched, nothing is certified, and fatal latches.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 现构造贵于最便宜构造 (进程内缝替代真值规模夹具) + 法条④ 同形状夹具第二份.

verdicts.test: R10 intra-surface multi-page normalized budget stops before later pages/surfaces
verdicts.contract: Claimed: budget exceeded mid-pagination abandons later pages and later surfaces. Actually proven here: budget exceeded while charging the reviews surface ⇒ later surfaces and the terminal PR are not fetched, fatal latches, nothing certified.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — after the rebuild both tests prove one law ('exceed ⇒ stop charging, fetch nothing further, certify nothing'), differing only in where in the loop the exceed happens; the genuine page-loop early-stop is proven elsewhere.

verdicts.test: snapshot and ledger size bounds fail loudly without truncation
verdicts.contract: An over-budget observe rejects loudly and latches fatal rather than truncating; plus an echo of the receipt byte constant.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — 'over budget ⇒ reject + fatal' is exactly the reject half already proven at test/collector-ledger.test.ts:1170-1191. 法条④ — the trailing constant assertion is a tautology (it restates src/collector-evidence.ts:13 and is duplicated verbatim at test/collector-receipt.test.ts:1431), while the real receipt-bound enforcement is covered at src/collector-receipt.ts:805 via test/collector-role.test.ts:2452/2644 and test/collector-receipt.test.ts:2731.

verdicts.test: observe stores immutable snapshot and recovers authenticated marker after ambiguous loss
verdicts.contract: observe certifies a complete snapshot (headOid, completedAt, completedMono, exactly 2 PR reads per bracket); after an ambiguous_loss POST the ledger stays unresolved with mutationGeneration>observedGeneration, and a later observe that finds the marker-bearing comment authored by the authenticated user flips it to recovered and stamps recoverySnapshotId.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — one tracer bullet through the real entry (observe → request → observe) over an in-memory fake transport; 19ms is digest work over real records, not fixture waste.

verdicts.test: observe start-before finish-after cutoff satisfies final obligation
verdicts.contract: An observe that starts before the cutoff and finishes after it satisfies the final-observation obligation (boundary case of the law proven at line 767).
verdicts.grounds: 法条④ 死代码测试 + 法条② (an assertion that cannot fail is not the cheapest proof of anything — it is zero proof at nonzero cost).

verdicts.test: output observation law rejects missing pre-cutoff and stale post-mutation
verdicts.contract: Output legality: 'missing' before cutoff is refused; 'unavailable' on a post-mutation stale observation is refused; a clean re-observe permits it; past cutoff a final observation crossing the deadline is required, and the receipt's finalObservationTime equals that snapshot's completedAt.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ + 法条② — one tracer through the real entries (observe → request → observe → advance → observe → buildCollectorReceipt), each assertion a different branch of one law; 6.96ms is digest work over real records.

verdicts.test: batch gate permits one operational or sole output and latches mixed/multiple
verdicts.contract: Batch admission gate: exactly one operational call is permitted (returns the permitted descriptor); mixed operational+request, operational+output, and a sole output without a completed operational/snapshot are denied and latch fatal.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 (同一契约重复证明) + 法条④ 同形状夹具第二份. 法条③ preserved: the must-reject rows survive the merge, none are deleted.

verdicts.test: evaluateBatch two-valid and invalid permutations latch fatal before execute
verdicts.contract: Any batch with more than one collector tool call — in every observed permutation — is denied and latches fatal before any execution.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (gate must-reject rows) + 法条② — table-driven over five permutations with a fresh ledger per row; this is the cheapest form and absorbs the line-117 duplicates.

verdicts.test: wait PR4 shape caps to five minutes so re-observe still fits before deadline
verdicts.contract: Same cap branch as the previous test, with elapsed time offset, plus: a subsequent observe still completes strictly before deadlineMono.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — the cap arithmetic (requested 900_000 → effective 300_000, remaining debited) is the same branch already proven at line 377-380; only the elapsed offset differs. 法条④ 同形状夹具第二份.

verdicts.test: HEAD move permits a new-head request once
verdicts.contract: process-local-once is scoped per head: after HEAD moves and a fresh observe, one more request for the same leg is allowed and binds the new head.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — the escape clause of the once-only gate, distinct from the refusal at line 345; two observes + two requests over an in-memory fake, 0.96ms.

verdicts.test: classifier rejects unknown, malformed, and schema-invalid without role
verdicts.contract: classifyCollectorBatch is a standalone gate: unknown tool name, wrong-typed call id, unknown extra argument, and wrong-typed tool argument are all rejected without any ledger/role state.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (闸类负向案不可删) + 法条② (pure function, literal batches, no fixture — already the cheapest proof).

verdicts.test: existing exact-head qualifying review blocks request via shared qualify law
verdicts.contract: A pre-existing exact-head, in-window qualifying review from an expected author makes request refuse (shared qualify law with the receipt).
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (must-reject on a gate) + 法条② (one fake-transport fixture, one rejects).

verdicts.test: beginOperational requires exact permitted batch match
verdicts.contract: beginOperational only runs for the exact (toolName, callId) permitted by the preceding evaluateBatch — bare ledger, wrong id, and wrong name all throw; repeating the exact match is idempotent.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ + 法条②: in-memory ledger only, no transport, no clock; four ledgers × one call each is already minimal.

verdicts.test: windowRelation matrix uses authoritative times only
verdicts.contract: computeWindowRelation classifies an authoritative timestamp against (activation, deadline): before / within at both edges / after / uncertain for null and unparsable input.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — cheapest possible construction already: pure function, table of 6 boundary rows, no fixture, no I/O.

verdicts.test: request enforces process-local once, observe-only, marker body, and cutoff
verdicts.contract: request refuses observe-only legs; succeeds once with a marker byte-equal to buildCollectorRequestMarker(digest, legId, head) and exactly one create call; a second request for the same leg is refused process-local-once; after cutoff it is refused and finalObservationRequired latches.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ + 法条② — four must-reject/must-accept clauses on one real request line, 0.46ms.

verdicts.test: R5 third observation of unchanged edited review keeps null/uncertain in modelView and store
verdicts.contract: Once an edited review's authoritativeTime is nulled, re-observing the unchanged edited version keeps null/uncertain in both the evidence store and the model-facing view, on the second and the third observation.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — the stickiness claim genuinely needs three observations, and the fixture is an in-memory fake; asserting on both the store and modelView is the real contract surface, not internal structure. Absorbs the line-949 test.

verdicts.test: repeated PR identity drift after retry fails closed without certifying
verdicts.contract: Drift that persists through the retry fails closed: exactly one full retry (4 PR reads), fatal latched with cause, zero evidence, zero snapshots, no latest snapshot id, and buildCollectorReceipt refuses.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (fail-closed must-reject, including the 'no partial evidence stored' assertions) + 法条② (0.35ms, same cheap fixture).

verdicts.test: R9 updatedAt churn forces full-surface retry and fails closed on repeated drift
verdicts.contract: updatedAt is part of the PR identity tuple: churn across the bracket forces the same full-surface retry (retry-visible evidence appears in the model view), and churn that persists fails closed without certifying.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — the retry law and the fail-closed law are already proven for the headOid key; this proves the identical two laws for the updatedAt key. 法条④ 同形状夹具第二份 (identical pullRequestSequence scripting, identical assertions).

verdicts.test: wait caps to remaining eligibility near cutoff and rejects after cutoff
verdicts.contract: When remaining eligibility is below the single-wait cap, remaining wins, cutoffReached latches, mutationGeneration bumps, and any further wait is rejected past cutoff.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ + 法条② — the other branch of the cap law (remaining < cap) plus the post-cutoff must-reject; distinct from line 366, clock-only, 0.31ms.

verdicts.test: after/uncertain exact-head review does not block request like before/within
verdicts.contract: A same-head review whose windowRelation is 'after' does not qualify, so request still succeeds — the positive counterpart of the qualify gate.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — distinct branch of the qualify law, same cheap fixture shape, 0.22ms.

verdicts.test: version history: later review edit without timestamp is uncertain
verdicts.contract: A post-deadline edit that GitHub still reports with the original submitted_at becomes a new version with authoritativeTime null / windowRelation uncertain, and the earlier version is retained.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — the line-1195 test's second observe (test/collector-ledger.test.ts:1217-1239) proves the identical claim (edited body ⇒ authoritativeTime null, windowRelation uncertain) and then goes further to the third observe and the modelView projection. 法条④ 同形状夹具第二份 (same transport fixture, same review edit script).

verdicts.test: wait caps a single call to five minutes when remaining eligibility is ample
verdicts.contract: When remaining eligibility exceeds the single-wait cap, one wait is capped to 300_000ms, remaining is debited, cutoffReached is false, and the ledger's waits() record mirrors requested/effective/cutoff.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — fake clock only, no transport; the cap branch plus the under-cap branch in one test is already the cheapest proof.

verdicts.test: terminal PR reread binds terminal HEAD and retries on drift
verdicts.contract: PR identity drift inside the observe bracket forces a full-surface retry, and the certified snapshot plus the stored PR evidence bind the terminal HEAD.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — pullRequestSequence on the existing fake is the cheapest way to script drift; 0.17ms.

verdicts.test: digest mutation flips versionId for enumerated stored fields
verdicts.contract: versionId digests exactly the enumerated stored fields for all three evidence normalizers — htmlUrl and userLogin for reviews, htmlUrl for issue comments, position and htmlUrl for review comments.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — pure normalizer calls on literal samples, no ledger, no transport, no clock; 0.15ms for six digest comparisons.

verdicts.test: R9 stable state+HEAD+updatedAt still single pass (2 PR reads)
verdicts.contract: No identity drift ⇒ no retry: exactly two PR reads (the terminal-reread bracket) for one observe.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 同根 — this exact assertion already exists inside another test, and standing alone it duplicates a single equality.

verdicts.test: applyEvidenceVersionHistory after-deadline mono first review nulls authoritativeTime
verdicts.contract: A first sighting after the deadline mono nulls authoritativeTime regardless of favourable wall time; a non-finite firstObservedMono also nulls; and a re-normalized known version reuses the stored null instead of re-applying submitted_at (R5).
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — direct calls into the history function with no fixture beyond one sample record; 0.06ms. Absorbs the line-1042 boundary row.

verdicts.test: applyEvidenceVersionHistory first review keeps submitted_at at/before deadline mono
verdicts.contract: Boundary: a first sighting whose firstObservedMono === deadlineMono keeps GitHub's submitted_at as authoritativeTime (mono is the trust axis, wall metadata is not).
verdicts.grounds: 法条④ 同形状夹具第二份 + 法条② — both tests are the same three-line shape (normalizeReviewEvidence(sampleReview(...)) → applyEvidenceVersionHistory(...) → assert authoritativeTime) over the same single boundary; one row table is the cheapest form.

verdicts.test: recorded r-block accepts via JSONL trust root and matches external expected
verdicts.contract: A checked-in r-block Judge recording is authentic (a uniquely bound assistant-call → start → terminal acceptance lifecycle in the JSONL trust root), neutral (no answer key on any model-visible surface), pinned to the current packaged Judge Soul, and its verdict direction matches the externally-held expected.json.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（现构造贵于最便宜构造：共享夹具 / 一次冷装全族复用 / 进程内缝替代子进程）+ 法条④（同一工作在家族内重复第二份）

verdicts.test: posture oracle rejects metadata package SHA with mismatched packaged Judge Soul
verdicts.contract: meta.soulDigest must equal the sha256 of souls/judge.md as packaged at meta.packageSha; a mismatched digest must throw a named error.
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（现构造贵于最便宜构造：进程内缝替代子进程）+ 法条④（重复的正向 = 死代码）

verdicts.test: recorded r-ready accepts via JSONL trust root and matches external expected
verdicts.contract: Same contract as r-block, for the construction-ready recording (expected direction: ready / allowedStatuses [converged]).
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（现构造贵于最便宜构造：共享夹具 / 进程内缝替代子进程）+ 法条④

verdicts.test: judge posture fixture bundles are present
verdicts.contract: The two posture bundle directories exist on disk.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② merge（与其他测试同根：同一契约重复证明）+ 法条② delete 子款（答不出契约）for the README half

verdicts.test: posture oracle refuses receipt-only trust without JSONL acceptance
verdicts.contract: Claimed: a self-asserted receipt with no JSONL acceptance bind is refused. Actually proved: a terminal whose content text is not the accepted marker is ignored.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② merge（与其他测试同根：同一契约重复证明），且本条是同根两者中较弱的一份

verdicts.test: JSONL bind/neutrality refuses coached user prompt against neutral static input
verdicts.contract: assertJsonlBoundNeutralInputs refuses any model-visible surface that carries an answer key or coaching.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；保留为 #19/#20 归并后的承载测试

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects call/start argument mismatch
verdicts.contract: The assistant-issued arguments must deep-equal the execution-start arguments, or the id is not evidence.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects same-id terminals with conflicting details
verdicts.contract: Two terminal representations of one toolCallId that disagree on payload reject the id — no last-write-wins.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: JSONL bind refuses materials-read body mismatch with static input
verdicts.contract: The static input/materials.md must byte-equal the materials body the model actually read in the JSONL — a swapped/coached body is refused.
verdicts.grounds: 法条④（同形状夹具第二份）+ 法条② merge（同一 gate 的同根证明）

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects orphan terminal without assistant call and start
verdicts.contract: A tool_execution_end acceptance terminal with no assistant-issued toolCall and no execution start is not evidence.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类契约的负向案不可删）；构造已是最便宜（3 行，复用 test:646-722 的共享 synthetic 工厂，0.21ms）

verdicts.test: JSONL bind refuses direction-labeled materials path in user prompt
verdicts.contract: A materials path carrying the oracle's direction label (r-block / r-ready) on a model-visible surface is refused.
verdicts.grounds: 法条④（同形状夹具第三份）+ 法条② merge（同一 gate 的同根证明）

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects orphan toolResult message without call chain
verdicts.contract: A toolResult-message acceptance terminal carrying the real accepted marker but no call/start chain is not evidence.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；且它是 #5 归并后的唯一正确承载者

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects missing isError even with full bind chain
verdicts.contract: Explicit success only — an absent/undefined isError never counts as acceptance, even with a complete call → start → terminal chain.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；4 行，最便宜构造

verdicts.test: acceptance parser keeps two distinct fully-bound ids with identical details
verdicts.contract: Two distinct fully-bound ids count as two even when details are identical — this is what makes the bundle rule 'exactly one accepted id' (test:739-743) able to bite.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③配套的正向计数案；构造最便宜（复用 syntheticBoundAcceptedChain，test:712-722）

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects terminal details that diverge from issued arguments
verdicts.contract: The accepted terminal's details must deep-equal what the assistant actually issued — a rewritten verdict is not evidence.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects out-of-order terminal before call and start
verdicts.contract: Row order must be call < start < every terminal; a terminal appearing first is not evidence.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects out-of-order start before call
verdicts.contract: An execution start preceding the assistant call is not a lawful lifecycle.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects conflicting or replayed assistant calls for one id
verdicts.contract: Same-id replay of the assistant call rejects the id even when the later payload would agree under last-write.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: acceptance parser binds full chain and merges agreeing terminals for one id
verdicts.contract: A complete call → start → agreeing-terminals chain for one id yields exactly one accepted verdict carrying the issued details — the positive that stops the gate from being vacuously strict.
verdicts.grounds: 闸的正向案（无它则全部负向案可被一个恒 reject 的 oracle 满足）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: acceptance parser rejects conflicting or replayed starts for one id
verdicts.contract: Same-id replay of the execution start rejects the id, symmetric to the call-replay rule.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③（闸类负向案不可删）；构造最便宜

verdicts.test: materializer installs exact common bundle and verifies readback
verdicts.contract: Materializing a valid bundle writes every entry's exact bytes to its relative clone path under the workspace and reports every entry as readback-verified.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② (契约本身就是文件系统契约，真 tmpdir 即最便宜构造)

verdicts.test: materializer rejects traversal, absolute paths, collisions, and symlink parents
verdicts.contract: Path-confinement gate: a bundle entry whose clone path escapes the workspace (traversal / absolute / colliding) or whose parent directory is a symlink must be rejected, so a reviewer bundle can never write outside the reviewed clone.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (闸类负向案不可删，只能修好) + 法条② (现构造证不出它自称的契约，且带死夹具)

verdicts.test: existing destination collision does not overwrite reviewed clone content
verdicts.contract: A pre-existing file at a destination path is never clobbered: materialization rejects with a collision error and the pre-existing bytes survive intact.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ (闸类负向案) + 法条② (真 tmpdir 是唯一能证明'原文件未被覆盖'的构造)

verdicts.test: materializer rejects digest and manifest mutation atomically
verdicts.contract: A bundle whose manifest digest or entry bytes have been tampered with is rejected before anything is written.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 臃肿款 (现构造贵于最便宜构造) + 法条④ (死夹具/名不副实)

verdicts.test: manifest schema file matches the packaged machine-readable contract
verdicts.contract: The shipped schemas/collector-legs-v1.schema.json is byte-equivalent to the exported COLLECTOR_LEGS_SCHEMA constant, and the body/author patterns are the two-character JSON-Schema \S (not a JS-escaped 'S').
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — a drift guard between a published artifact and the code constant can only be proved by comparing them; the deepEqual at :154 plus the behavioral regex oracle at :143-147 is that cheapest form. 62.20ms is the file read.

verdicts.test: manifest rejects wrong version, unknown fields, empty legs, bad ids, and author problems
verdicts.contract: 14 semantic manifest violations (version type, unknown top/leg/request fields, empty legs, id grammar, duplicate ids, empty/blank/duplicate/cross-leg-overlapping authors, empty body) are each rejected.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — 14 must-reject cases of the manifest gate. 法条② 22.95ms via one shared temp dir and one table.

verdicts.test: manifest rejects unreadable path, non-UTF-8, malformed JSON, and duplicate keys
verdicts.contract: Missing file, invalid UTF-8 bytes, malformed JSON, and duplicate keys — top-level, nested, and unicode-escaped — are all rejected.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ gate negatives; the escaped-duplicate case (:228-233) is the kind of counterexample only a real parser test catches. 法条② 21.34ms for 6 rows on real files.

verdicts.test: request body enforces trim-non-empty content and exact 60_000 UTF-8 byte bound
verdicts.contract: A body of exactly 60,000 UTF-8 bytes (multi-byte characters) is accepted, 60,001 is rejected, and whitespace-only is rejected — i.e. the bound is bytes, not characters.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ boundary gate with both sides of the edge; 法条② 13.82ms.

verdicts.test: manifest loads, normalizes authors, and digests canonical JSON stably
verdicts.contract: Loading normalizes author casing/whitespace, omits an absent request body, produces a stable 64-hex digest across two loads, and the canonical JSON carries only normalized authors.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② 6.38ms through the real loader on a real temp file — the happy-path tracer bullet the negative tests hang off.

verdicts.test: loadCollectorManifest does not invoke any transport or provider side effects
verdicts.contract: NONE — the stated contract ('invokes no transport or provider side effects') is not what the test asserts.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — 只测内部结构 / 对名字建机械依赖: the load-bearing assertion is `"createGitHubTransport" in (await import("../src/collector-config.ts")) === false`, a dependency on the ABSENCE of an export name, which is module structure, not behavior. It is also not protected by 法条③: it is not a must-reject case of a gate, it is a structural proxy for one.

verdicts.test: repository grammar accepts owner/repo boundaries and lowercases identity
verdicts.contract: parseCollectorRepository accepts minimum and maximum-length owner/repo, canonicalizes to lowercase while preserving display casing, and rejects over-length parts.
verdicts.grounds: 法条② — pure function, 1.23ms; no cheaper construction exists.

verdicts.test: repository grammar rejects URLs, credentials, punctuation edges, and control bytes
verdicts.contract: 26 hostile repository spellings (URL, query, fragment, credentials, path traversal shapes, whitespace, non-ASCII, control byte, newline, punctuation endpoints) are rejected, while legal middle punctuation is accepted.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ — 26 must-reject cases of an input gate, unconditionally protected. 法条② 0.50ms, and it pairs the negatives with positives (:108-109) so the gate cannot be satisfied by rejecting everything.

verdicts.test: PR number accepts only positive safe integers
verdicts.contract: Only positive safe integers parse; zero, negative, fractional, leading-zero, exponent, NaN, over-MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and empty are rejected.
verdicts.grounds: 法条③ gate negatives with boundary values; 法条② 0.25ms.

verdicts.test: acceptance is irreversible and concurrent proposals start exactly once
verdicts.contract: 并发 propose 下接受不可逆：一个 accepted 一个 closed，provider 恰好启动一次（starts===1）。
verdicts.grounds: 法条②（契约清晰；构造为进程内并发，无外部成本）
